policy: Large third-party source trees are restored locally; this lock, explicit patches, and small compatibility components belong in the project repository.

components.name: arduino
components.notes: The bootstrap applies dependencies/patches/arduino.patch and installs the minimal tracked IDF manifest from dependencies/compat/arduino.

components.name: bluepad32
components.notes: The component is restored from src/components/bluepad32 and patched for ESP32-S3, the disabled Bluepad32 REPL, and the locked BTstack API.

components.name: bluepad32_arduino
components.notes: The small Arduino adapter is tracked under dependencies/compat and makes the upstream template console integration optional for PGOS.

components.name: btstack
components.notes: BTstack is the revision used by Bluepad32 4.2.0. The bootstrap assembles its ESP32 component subset and applies the two documented pairing/security patches.

components.name: lvgl
components.notes: The bootstrap restores the exact upstream revision; demos and examples remain disabled by sdkconfig.

components.name: esp_lcd_ili9341
components.notes: Official Espressif panel driver. Its source is restored into ignored managed_components by main/idf_component.yml.
